title: South Karelia: what a EUR 1,000,000 annual lung cancer budget should buy first
markdown:
# South Karelia: what a EUR 1,000,000 annual lung cancer budget should buy first

## The gap in one sentence
In 2019–2023, 42.8% of South Karelia's lung cancer patients had no treatment on record, against 27.5% nationally (rank 2 of 22) [^fcr_lung_quality_report]. Only 18.9% got curative-intent treatment, against 27.0% nationally; the gap to the top-quartile county rate is about 8.1 patients a year, arithmetic on registry shares rather than a causal estimate [^fcr_lung_quality_report]. The model estimates 155 days (145–166) from first symptom to treatment start, the 9th longest of 23 counties [^model].

## Where the days are lost
Among the estimated steps, only first specialist visit to diagnosis runs above the national figure: 13 days (10–16) against 12 [^model]. The model's estimate for that step is pushed up by an assumed effect of a measured 256.8 km to the nearest university hospital, against 86.8 km nationally [^osm_nominatim_university_hospitals]. A short pulmonology queue partly offsets it: 2.2% waited over 90 days, against 13.0% nationally [^thl_eshjono_pulmonology_queue_over_90d_pct]. Diagnosis to treatment start is measured at 40.7 days for the Southern Finland (HUS) collaborative area, weighted by the county's treatment mix, against 36.9 nationally; surgery there takes 46 days [^src_fi_assets_files_2024_12_Keuhkosyopa_Suomessa_pdf_p28].

## Three actions
1. **What:** A symptom awareness campaign telling people with a cough lasting over three weeks to see a doctor. **Owner:** FICAN and the Cancer Society nationally; county communications and primary care locally. **Cost:** EUR 10,241 a year, sourced from the roadmap budget; repeating it yearly is an assumption [^model]. **Expected effect:** 0 days saved; 0.29 (0.13–0.44) deaths avoided a year, estimated [^model]. **Evidence:** Stage I share rose 3.1 points in England's before-after evaluation; a regional pilot was not significant [^ev_symptom_campaign_1]. **Roadmap:** 1.3.2, national symptom-awareness communication plan [^roadmap_1.3.2].
2. **What:** Smoking cessation medication and counselling at the first specialist visit. **Owner:** Chief physician and head nurse of pulmonology. **Cost:** EUR 29,400 a year, an assumption [^model]. **Expected effect:** 0 days saved; 0.17 deaths avoided a year in the plan (0.24, 0.16–0.3, on its own), estimated [^model]. **Evidence:** An observational cohort found hazard ratio 0.67 for mortality after quitting [^ev_smoking_cessation_at_diagnosis_1][^ev_smoking_cessation_at_diagnosis_2]. **Roadmap:** 3.1.2, cancer-specific care pathways [^roadmap_3.1.2].
3. **What:** Low-dose CT screening for 50–74-year-old long-term heavy smokers. **Owner:** Ministry and Palko decide, the Cancer Registry steers, the county delivers. **Cost:** EUR 392,714 a year, an assumption [^model]. **Expected effect:** 0 days saved; 2.17 deaths avoided a year in the plan (2.3, 1.69–2.92, on its own), estimated; the benefit arrives after years [^model]. **Evidence:** A meta-analysis of nine trials found relative rate 0.84 [^ev_ldct_screening_1][^ev_ldct_screening_2]. **Roadmap:** 2.3.4, new national screening programmes [^roadmap_2.3.4].

None of these three actions shortens the pathway [^model]. The full plan has nine measures, costs EUR 993,043 and is estimated to avoid 2.93 (2.22–3.67) deaths a year [^model].

## What to measure from Monday
- Referral date and first pulmonology visit date for every suspected lung cancer.
- Date of first symptom and first primary care contact.
- Specialist-visit-to-diagnosis and diagnosis-to-treatment dates for the county itself.
- Stage at diagnosis and whether a multidisciplinary team (MDT) meeting was recorded.

## Limits of this analysis
The step days are county-level estimates built from national medians and assumed priors, not measurements of individual pathways [^model]. As a check, not a validation, 0 of 3 measured outcomes correlated with the estimated clock beyond chance [^model]. The 155-day national total was reported by Yle in 2026 from an unpublished four-city Finnish study [^src_yle_fi_a_74_20250979].

flagged.reason: The 8.1 figure is arithmetic on registry shares, explicitly not a causal estimate; 'would get' implied a causal effect. Rewritten as a gap with its kind stated.

flagged.sentence: That step is associated with a measured 256.8 km to the nearest university hospital, against 86.8 km nationally [^osm_nominatim_university_hospitals].
flagged.reason: 'Associated with' implied an observed relationship; the distance only enters the step estimate through an assumed prior elasticity. Rewritten to say the model's estimate is pushed up by an assumed effect of the measured distance.

flagged.reason: Factual claim without a source marker; supported by the model output (shortens_pathway false), so [^model] was added.
